_about: Skill auras for the Minions hunt (lib\tasks\Minions.ahk, MinionsTask.Auras / MinionSkills). Keys are aura names in lower case. panel: the skill rows top to bottom as on screen (rows fill the panel's lowest slots). order: keys to cast, first ready wins (a key left out is never cast). skills: per key, name as on the panel, cool = cooldown ms (the overlay), cast = ms from the press to the overlay's start, cost = resource points it needs, roots = no movement during its cast, needsRank = combo rank it needs. strategy: 'eden' (Eden's hand-written rule), 'order' (first ready in order); auras not listed use default.strategy ('learn': read the panel's key letters, else press every letter and learn the rows; cooldowns learnt from the overlay go to data\auras_learnt.json). readers: extra HUD reads ('charge' = Eden's points bar, 'rank' = its combo letter). deathScreen: true = the dark red death screen (DeathScreen) counts as a death. "unknown" = not measured: never invented.
